about: Every source file of the Quay Street sound (unit 10, cloud week 42). fetch_sources.py fills in each entry from the source's own page, refuses any whose page does not say CC0, and records the md5 of the downloaded file. The files are not in git; make_sound.py rebuilds every output from them.

rejected.why: its own page mentions a beer delivery in the background: alcohol is out of the game, so the file is not used
waves, gulls and people at a public quay in summer: people, children likely; not used
its page says children can be heard screaming; not used
CC0, but the author's page states he does not consent to use in training generative models; the project works with AI tools, so not used

rejected.what: accented steps (Jess_Weddle_6121), footsteps on a cobblestone street
rejected.why: the only cobblestone footsteps found, but a walk-through at about 6 dB signal-to-noise; one step in 45 passed the clean-step tests
99 percent of its energy is wind below 100 Hz; the gulls are buried
the takes open with an 'audio intro' (a comment on the page, thanking the author for it); the first 12 s are cut off in the three used (182610, 182611, 182612)

rejected.what: two-person wet footsteps (evsecrets), hardwood footsteps (kgopong), quiet night traffic (brunoboselli)
rejected.why: fetched and tried; none of their steps or stretches was chosen, so they are not in the build

rejected.what: wooden floor, old, creaking, footsteps, walking.WAV (VMan533)
rejected.why: a wooden-floor steps take used in the first build; after the review the footstep cutter judges each step against its own peak, and none of its 66 onsets dies away by 20 dB (a noisy take; at 14 dB only 3 do), so no footfall of it is left to use. Retired on 12 October 2026 (NOTES.md, 'Changed after the review'); its page had been read and states CC0
